datasets.name: rom_tonase_by_kontraktor
queryLines:
WITH date_params AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(:date_from, DATE '2026-07-12') as date_from,
    COALESCE(:date_to, COALESCE(:date_from, DATE '2026-07-12')) as date_to,
    COALESCE(:shift_from, 'ALL') as shift_from,
    COALESCE(:shift_to, 'ALL') as shift_to,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(:hour_from, 'ALL'), '-1') as hour_from,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(:hour_to, 'ALL'), '-1') as hour_to
)
SELECT
  r.op_date,
  r.master_location,
  r.kontraktor,
  r.hour,
  r.shift,
  r.tonase,
  r.jumlah_unit_aktif,
  r.jumlah_transaksi
FROM
  uc.urise.rom r CROSS JOIN date_params p
WHERE
  (
    -- Single date case
    (
      p.date_from = p.date_to
      AND r.op_date = p.date_from
      AND (
        (
          p.shift_from = 'ALL'
          AND p.shift_to = 'ALL'
        )
        OR (
          p.shift_from != 'ALL'
          AND p.shift_to = 'ALL'
          AND r.shift = p.shift_from
        )
        OR (
          p.shift_from = 'ALL'
          AND p.shift_to != 'ALL'
          AND r.shift = p.shift_to
        )
        OR (
          p.shift_from != 'ALL'
          AND p.shift_to != 'ALL'
          AND r.shift IN (p.shift_from, p.shift_to)
        )
      )
      AND (
        (
          p.hour_from = '-1'
          AND p.hour_to = '-1'
        )
        OR (
          p.hour_from != '-1'
          AND p.hour_to = '-1'
          AND r.hour >= CAST(p.hour_from AS INT)
        )
        OR (
          p.hour_from = '-1'
          AND p.hour_to != '-1'
          AND r.hour <= CAST(p.hour_to AS INT)
        )
        OR (
          p.hour_from != '-1'
          AND p.hour_to != '-1'
          AND (
            (
              CAST(p.hour_from AS INT) <= CAST(p.hour_to AS INT)
              AND r.hour BETWEEN CAST(p.hour_from AS INT) AND CAST(p.hour_to AS INT)
            )
            OR (
              CAST(p.hour_from AS INT) > CAST(p.hour_to AS INT)
              AND (
                r.hour >= CAST(p.hour_from AS INT)
                OR r.hour <= CAST(p.hour_to AS INT)
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
    OR ( -- Start date with filters
      p.date_from < p.date_to
      AND r.op_date = p.date_from
      AND (
        (p.shift_from = 'ALL')
        OR r.shift = p.shift_from
      )
      AND (
        (p.hour_from = '-1')
        OR r.hour >= CAST(p.hour_from AS INT)
      )
    )
    OR ( -- Middle dates (no filters)
      p.date_from < p.date_to
      AND r.op_date > p.date_from
      AND r.op_date <= p.date_to
      AND p.shift_to = 'ALL'
      AND p.hour_to = '-1'
    )
    OR ( -- End date with filters
      p.date_from < p.date_to
      AND r.op_date = p.date_to
      AND (
        p.shift_to != 'ALL'
        OR p.hour_to != '-1'
      )
      AND (
        (p.shift_to = 'ALL')
        OR r.shift = p.shift_to
      )
      AND (
        (p.hour_to = '-1')
        OR r.hour <= CAST(p.hour_to AS INT)
      )
    )
  )
ORDER BY
  op_date,
  master_location,
  kontraktor,
  hour

datasets.name: heatmap_hourly_singleday
queryLines:
WITH date_params AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(:date_from, DATE '2026-07-12') as date_from,
    COALESCE(:date_to, COALESCE(:date_from, DATE '2026-07-12')) as date_to,
    COALESCE(:shift_from, 'ALL') as shift_from,
    COALESCE(:shift_to, 'ALL') as shift_to,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(:hour_from, 'ALL'), '-1') as hour_from,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(:hour_to, 'ALL'), '-1') as hour_to
)
SELECT
  r.master_location,
  r.hour,
  r.op_hour as sort_order,
  date_format(timestampadd(HOUR, r.hour, r.date), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH') as rdate,
  SUM(r.jumlah_unit_aktif) as sum_jumlah_unit_aktif
FROM
  uc.urise.rom r CROSS JOIN date_params p
WHERE
  -- CONDITIONAL VISIBILITY: tampil hanya jika single day
  p.date_from = p.date_to
  AND r.op_date = p.date_from
  AND (
    (
      p.shift_from = 'ALL'
      AND p.shift_to = 'ALL'
    )
    OR (
      p.shift_from != 'ALL'
      AND p.shift_to = 'ALL'
      AND r.shift = p.shift_from
    )
    OR (
      p.shift_from = 'ALL'
      AND p.shift_to != 'ALL'
      AND r.shift = p.shift_to
    )
    OR (
      p.shift_from != 'ALL'
      AND p.shift_to != 'ALL'
      AND r.shift IN (p.shift_from, p.shift_to)
    )
  )
  AND (
    (
      p.hour_from = '-1'
      AND p.hour_to = '-1'
    )
    OR (
      p.hour_from != '-1'
      AND p.hour_to = '-1'
      AND r.hour >= CAST(p.hour_from AS INT)
    )
    OR (
      p.hour_from = '-1'
      AND p.hour_to != '-1'
      AND r.hour <= CAST(p.hour_to AS INT)
    )
    OR (
      p.hour_from != '-1'
      AND p.hour_to != '-1'
      AND (
        (
          CAST(p.hour_from AS INT) <= CAST(p.hour_to AS INT)
          AND r.hour BETWEEN CAST(p.hour_from AS INT) AND CAST(p.hour_to AS INT)
        )
        OR (
          CAST(p.hour_from AS INT) > CAST(p.hour_to AS INT)
          AND (
            r.hour >= CAST(p.hour_from AS INT)
            OR r.hour <= CAST(p.hour_to AS INT)
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
GROUP BY
  r.master_location,
  r.hour,
  r.date,
  r.op_hour,
  date_format(timestampadd(HOUR, r.hour, r.date), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH')
ORDER BY
  r.master_location,
  r.date,
  r.op_hour,
  rdate

datasets.name: heatmap_daily_multiday
queryLines:
WITH date_params AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(:date_from, DATE '2026-07-12') as date_from,
    COALESCE(:date_to, COALESCE(:date_from, DATE '2026-07-12')) as date_to,
    COALESCE(:shift_from, 'ALL') as shift_from,
    COALESCE(:shift_to, 'ALL') as shift_to,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(:hour_from, 'ALL'), '-1') as hour_from,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(:hour_to, 'ALL'), '-1') as hour_to
)
SELECT
  r.op_date,
  r.master_location,
  SUM(r.jumlah_unit_aktif) as sum_jumlah_unit_aktif
FROM
  uc.urise.rom r CROSS JOIN date_params p
WHERE
  -- CONDITIONAL VISIBILITY: tampil hanya jika multi-day
  p.date_from < p.date_to
  AND (
    ( -- Start date with filters
      r.op_date = p.date_from
      AND (
        (p.shift_from = 'ALL')
        OR r.shift = p.shift_from
      )
      AND (
        (p.hour_from = '-1')
        OR r.hour >= CAST(p.hour_from AS INT)
      )
    )
    OR ( -- Middle dates (no filters) - include end date
      r.op_date > p.date_from
      AND r.op_date <= p.date_to
      AND p.shift_to = 'ALL'
      AND p.hour_to = '-1'
    )
    OR ( -- End date with filters
      r.op_date = p.date_to
      AND (
        p.shift_to != 'ALL'
        OR p.hour_to != '-1'
      )
      AND (
        (p.shift_to = 'ALL')
        OR r.shift = p.shift_to
      )
      AND (
        (p.hour_to = '-1')
        OR r.hour <= CAST(p.hour_to AS INT)
      )
    )
  )
GROUP BY
  r.op_date,
  r.master_location
ORDER BY
  r.op_date,
  r.master_location

datasets.name: 02_sebaran_unit
queryLines:
WITH latest_position AS (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.deviceid ORDER BY p.fixtime DESC) AS rn
  FROM
    uc.famous.tc_positions p
  WHERE
    p.latitude != 0
    AND p.longitude != 0
)
SELECT
  CAST(d.id AS STRING) AS unit_id,
  d.name AS no_lambung,
  SPLIT(d.name, ' ')[0] AS kontraktor,
  CASE
    WHEN
      UPPER(d.name) LIKE '% EV%'
      OR UPPER(d.category) = 'EXCAVATOR'
    THEN
      'EV'
    WHEN UPPER(d.name) LIKE '% DDT%' THEN 'DDT'
    WHEN UPPER(d.name) LIKE '% SDT%' THEN 'SDT'
    WHEN
      UPPER(d.name) LIKE '% DT%'
      OR UPPER(d.category) = 'TRUCK'
    THEN
      'DT'
    WHEN
      UPPER(d.name) LIKE '% LV%'
      OR UPPER(d.category) IN ('CAR', 'LIGHT_VEHICLE')
    THEN
      'LV'
    ELSE COALESCE(d.category, 'OTHER')
  END AS jenis_unit,
  lp.latitude,
  lp.longitude,
  ROUND(lp.speed * 1.852, 1) AS speed_kmh,
  lp.course AS heading,
  CASE
    WHEN d.status = 'offline' THEN 'MATI'
    WHEN
      d.motionstate = 0
      AND lp.geofenceids LIKE '%:true%'
    THEN
      'OUT_OF_HAULING'
    WHEN
      d.motionstate = 1
      AND lp.geofenceids LIKE '%:true%'
    THEN
      'MUATAN'
    WHEN d.motionstate = 1 THEN 'KOSONG'
    WHEN d.motionstate = 0 THEN 'MATI'
    ELSE 'KOSONG'
  END AS status_operasional,
  g.name AS zona_geofence,
  COALESCE(g.group_name, 'OUTSIDE') AS zona_type,
  lp.fixtime AS last_update,
  TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, lp.fixtime, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) AS data_age_seconds
FROM
  latest_position lp
    JOIN uc.famous.master_tc_device d
      ON lp.deviceid = d.id
    LEFT JOIN uc.famous.tc_geofences g
      ON lp.geofenceids LIKE CONCAT('%"in', CAST(g.id AS STRING), '":true%')
WHERE
  lp.rn = 1

datasets.name: 05_cp_realtime_monitoring
queryLines:
WITH latest_hourly AS (
  SELECT
    queue_name,
    transaction_date,
    transaction_hour,
    total_transaction,
    vehicle_in,
    vehicle_out,
    total_tonnage,
    avg_cp_area_duration_minutes,
    avg_queue_duration_minutes,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY queue_name
        ORDER BY transaction_date DESC, transaction_hour DESC
      ) as rn
  FROM
    `uc`.`synova`.`gold_uc05_cp_vehicle_hourly_summary`
),
cp_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    queue_name,
    vehicle_in - vehicle_out AS estimated_queue_length,
    vehicle_in - vehicle_out AS estimated_active_units,
    total_tonnage AS tph,
    100.0 AS installed_capacity_tph,
    (total_tonnage / 100.0) * 100 AS utilization_percentage,
    CASE
      WHEN (vehicle_in - vehicle_out) > 8 THEN 'ALERT'
      ELSE 'NORMAL'
    END AS alert_status,
    vehicle_in AS total_vehicle_in,
    vehicle_out AS total_vehicle_out,
    total_tonnage,
    avg_cp_area_duration_minutes,
    avg_queue_duration_minutes
  FROM
    latest_hourly
  WHERE
    rn = 1
)
SELECT
  *
FROM
  cp_metrics

datasets.name: 05_cp_shift_comparison
queryLines:
WITH shift_data AS (
  SELECT
    transaction_date,
    transaction_hour,
    queue_name,
    port,
    vehicle_in,
    vehicle_out,
    total_tonnage,
    avg_cp_area_duration_minutes,
    CASE
      WHEN
        transaction_hour >= 6
        AND transaction_hour < 18
      THEN
        'Day Shift'
      ELSE 'Night Shift'
    END AS shift_name,
    CASE
      WHEN transaction_hour < 6 THEN DATE_SUB(transaction_date, 1)
      ELSE transaction_date
    END AS shift_date
  FROM
    `uc`.`synova`.`gold_uc05_cp_vehicle_hourly_summary`
)
SELECT
  shift_name,
  queue_name,
  SUM(vehicle_in) AS total_vehicle_in,
  SUM(vehicle_out) AS total_vehicle_out,
  SUM(total_tonnage) AS total_tonnage,
  AVG(total_tonnage) AS avg_tph,
  AVG(avg_cp_area_duration_minutes) AS avg_cp_area_duration_minutes
FROM
  shift_data
GROUP BY
  shift_name,
  queue_name

datasets.name: 05_cp_kpi_summary
queryLines:
WITH latest_data AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT queue_name) AS total_cp_monitored,
    SUM(total_vehicle_in) AS total_vehicle_in,
    SUM(total_vehicle_out) AS total_vehicle_out,
    SUM(total_transaction) AS total_transaction,
    SUM(total_tonnage) AS total_tonnage,
    AVG(avg_cp_area_duration_minutes) AS avg_cp_area_duration,
    SUM(anomaly_count) AS anomaly_count,
    SUM(data_quality_issue_count) AS data_quality_issue_count
  FROM
    `uc`.`synova`.`gold_uc05_cp_vehicle_daily_summary`
),
queue_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(vehicle_in - vehicle_out) AS total_queue_length,
    SUM(vehicle_in - vehicle_out) AS total_active_units,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN (vehicle_in - vehicle_out) > 8 THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS alert_count,
    AVG(total_tonnage) AS avg_tph
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        queue_name,
        vehicle_in,
        vehicle_out,
        total_tonnage,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY queue_name
            ORDER BY transaction_date DESC, transaction_hour DESC
          ) as rn
      FROM
        `uc`.`synova`.`gold_uc05_cp_vehicle_hourly_summary`
    )
  WHERE
    rn = 1
)
SELECT
  ld.total_cp_monitored,
  COALESCE(qm.total_queue_length, 0) AS total_queue_length,
  COALESCE(qm.total_active_units, 0) AS total_active_units,
  COALESCE(qm.avg_tph, 0) AS avg_tph,
  ld.total_tonnage,
  ld.total_vehicle_in,
  ld.total_vehicle_out,
  ld.avg_cp_area_duration,
  COALESCE(qm.alert_count, 0) AS alert_count,
  ld.data_quality_issue_count
FROM
  latest_data ld CROSS JOIN queue_metrics qm

datasets.name: 05_ds_comparison_delta_by_cp
queryLines:
WITH left_period AS (
  SELECT
    queue_name,
    SUM(total_vehicle_in) AS vehicle_in,
    SUM(total_tonnage) AS total_tonnage,
    SUM(total_tonnage) / NULLIF(SUM(total_vehicle_in), 0) AS tph
  FROM
    `uc`.`synova`.`gold_uc05_cp_vehicle_daily_summary`
  WHERE
    transaction_date >= :left_start_ts
    AND transaction_date <= :left_end_ts
  GROUP BY
    queue_name
),
right_period AS (
  SELECT
    queue_name,
    SUM(total_vehicle_in) AS vehicle_in,
    SUM(total_tonnage) AS total_tonnage,
    SUM(total_tonnage) / NULLIF(SUM(total_vehicle_in), 0) AS tph
  FROM
    `uc`.`synova`.`gold_uc05_cp_vehicle_daily_summary`
  WHERE
    transaction_date >= :right_start_ts
    AND transaction_date <= :right_end_ts
  GROUP BY
    queue_name
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(l.queue_name, r.queue_name) AS queue_name,
  COALESCE(l.vehicle_in, 0) AS left_vehicle_in,
  COALESCE(r.vehicle_in, 0) AS right_vehicle_in,
  COALESCE(r.vehicle_in, 0) - COALESCE(l.vehicle_in, 0) AS delta_vehicle_in,
  ROUND(
    (COALESCE(r.vehicle_in, 0) - COALESCE(l.vehicle_in, 0)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(l.vehicle_in, 0),
    1
  ) AS delta_vehicle_in_pct,
  COALESCE(l.total_tonnage, 0) AS left_total_tonnage,
  COALESCE(r.total_tonnage, 0) AS right_total_tonnage,
  COALESCE(r.total_tonnage, 0) - COALESCE(l.total_tonnage, 0) AS delta_total_tonnage,
  ROUND(
    (COALESCE(r.total_tonnage, 0) - COALESCE(l.total_tonnage, 0))
      * 100.0
      / NULLIF(l.total_tonnage, 0),
    1
  ) AS delta_total_tonnage_pct,
  COALESCE(l.tph, 0) AS left_tph,
  COALESCE(r.tph, 0) AS right_tph,
  COALESCE(r.tph, 0) - COALESCE(l.tph, 0) AS delta_tph,
  ROUND((COALESCE(r.tph, 0) - COALESCE(l.tph, 0)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(l.tph, 0), 1) AS delta_tph_pct
FROM
  left_period l
    FULL OUTER JOIN right_period r
      ON l.queue_name = r.queue_name
